note: `listId` is required — a delete names one list; there is no delete-all.
Unknown member — additionalProperties: false catches `deleteContacts`. Deleting a list never deletes a contact; that is persona/contact/delete, one contact at a time.
Response without `existed` — a repeated delete must be distinguishable from the first.
Response echoing the list's name — additionalProperties: false; nothing deleted is echoed into logs that outlive it.
